theme: Hybrid (Light theme default for Student Focus, High-Contrast Light/Dark for Professor Dashboard)

typography.student_editor_headings: Spectral or Cormorant Garamond (Serif, Elegant, conveys academic authority)
typography.student_editor_body: Source Serif Pro or IBM Plex Serif (High legibility, traditional document feel)
typography.ui_headings_professor: Cabinet Grotesk (Sharp, authoritative, technical for dashboard density)
typography.ui_body: IBM Plex Sans (Clean, tabular numbers, perfect for dashboard readability)
rules: NO Inter for headings. Banned fonts: Space Grotesk.
Tight letter spacing for Headings (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Overlines / Labels / Column Headers MUST be Uppercase + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

student_space.background: #F9F9F8 (Warm paper-like off-white for the editor container)
student_space.surface: #FFFFFF (Pure white editor canvas with soft drop shadow)

professor_dashboard.background: #F1F5F9 (Cool neutral grey to make white widgets pop)
professor_dashboard.alert_critical: #D90429 (Signal Red for high-confidence AI pastes / Flags)

rules: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Always tint greys with a subtle blue or orange.
Ensure text meets APCA standards. Use text shadow if placing text over images.
ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. Focus states must have HIGHER contrast.

surfaces.name: Crystal Glassmorphism
surfaces.usage: Student AI Sidebar (when overlapping content) & Floating Toolbars

surfaces.name: Technical Grid Borders
surfaces.usage: Professor Dashboard Metrics & Flag Data Tables
surfaces.classes: border-collapse border-r border-b border-border/40 (expose the skeleton of the layout)

student_view.description: Distraction-free editor on the left (70%), Course-Scoped AI sidebar on the right (30%).
student_view.grid_classes: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-0 h-screen overflow-hidden
student_view.editor_span: lg:col-span-8 xl:col-span-9 flex justify-center overflow-y-auto bg-[#F9F9F8] py-20
student_view.ai_span: lg:col-span-4 xl:col-span-3 border-l border-border bg-white shadow-[-4px_0_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)] relative z-10

professor_dashboard.description: Dense data tracking for student integrity, flags, and monitoring. Left side-nav, right dense grid.
professor_dashboard.grid_classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 p-8

components.student_editor: Use a minimal HTML/Tailwind contenteditable div or lightweight rich text wrapper. Include a minimal contextual floating toolbar (slash command or pop-up on highlight) to keep the canvas clean.
components.professor_dashboard: Use Shadcn/UI for Data Tables, Tabs, Select (Strictness level), and Badges (Alerts).
components.charts: Shadcn chart components (Recharts) for keystroke/paste timeline monitoring.
components.toasts: Use Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., flag resolved, AI usage declaration sent).

rules: Smooth slide-in for the AI Sidebar (Framer Motion).
Subtle highlight fade-in for flagged pasted text.
Sonner for Toast notifications (successful submission, AI usage declaration sent).
Disable transforms in universal transitions; apply specifically to interactive elements.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='submit-assignment-btn', data-testid='resolve-flag-btn').
accessibility.contrast: APCA contrast ratio focus. Explicit hover/focus states for all buttons.

student_auth_bg.description: Calm student studying at a library, useful for the Student Login / Auth page background.

professor_auth_bg.description: Concentrated study/review environment, useful for the Professor Dashboard Login.

abstract_network.description: Abstract data nodes, good for 'Monitoring Setup' or 'Course Material AI Context' empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Google Login for school emails as the primary authentication method on the entry page.
Build the Student Editor to feel like a premium writing tool (Grammarly/Notion). Center the document context block (e.g., max-w-3xl) to maintain a readable line length.
Implement the 'Course-Scoped AI' as a sticky right-side panel that answers strictly from uploaded context. Include an 'Ask the Teacher' thread fallback within the AI UI.
For the Professor Dashboard, utilize dense Shadcn tables to list 'Flags' (pastes, tab switches, high-AI likelihood) with progressive disclosure (drawer/modal to view details).
Include an 'Inbox' on the Student side for them to submit 'AI-usage statements/explanations' for flagged items.
Professor Course Setup must have distinct sections for uploading PDFs/Text for AI context and a slider/select for monitoring strictness.
Do NOT use HTML <input type='date'> or <select>. Use Shadcn UI equivalents.
Use Lucide-React or Phosphor Icons. NEVER use emoji placeholders.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate, BUT NEVER use a fully transparent background over content.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Apply them specifically to interactive properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden). Optical left-alignment preferred.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or crisp rectangles) with interaction animations.
NEVER use placeholder URLs or AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Include a `data-testid` attribute on all key interactive elements.
Provide clear empty states with actionable guidance.
